clue.text: She just about makes it to the top of the staff

definitions.text: She just about makes it to the top of the staff

parts.words: She just about makes it to the top of the staff
parts.note: a female singer whose voice reaches nearly, but not quite, the highest notes on the musical stave: half-way to the highest voice

explanation.definitionFit: Mezzo means half, and this voice sits between alto and the highest female range, so it climbs most of the way up the stave.

clue.text: Confused dream is wrongly interpreted

indicators.note: confused letters are jumbled up, so the words that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone muddled by a dream gets its meaning wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To get the sense of something wrong is to take it the wrong way in reading or understanding.

clue.text: Zulu leader on river in African republic

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, so take the start of Zulu

parts.note: the Aire is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A Zulu chief sits beside a river in an African country.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts Z above AIRE; the Aire is a river in northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Zaire was the name of the Democratic Republic of the Congo from 1971 to 1997.

clue.text: John raised essential points about old egg collectors

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the word is written bottom to top, so it reads backwards

parts.note: john is slang for a lavatory, a loo
the gists of matters are their essential points

explanation.surface: A man called John lifts the main points about old egg collectors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns LOO to OOL; 'about' simply links the pieces as 'concerning'.
explanation.definitionFit: Oology is the study and collecting of birds' eggs, so its practitioners gather such eggs.

clue.text: Broadcast on recently deceased monastic dedicatee

parts.note: OB stands for outside broadcast
the late person is one recently dead

explanation.surface: A broadcast about a recently dead person who had dedicated themselves to a monastery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' places OB above LATE in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblate is a layperson dedicated to a religious order, living under its rule without full vows.

clue.text: About to fill 18 dn in again?

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to occupy a space is to fill it

explanation.surface: A question about filling a place to live in all over again.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 down is RESIDE, so the definition means 'live in again'.
explanation.definitionFit: To take possession of and live in a place once more is to dwell there anew.

clue.text: Some spurn a humble prophet

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A humble prophet is rejected by some people.
explanation.definitionFit: Nahum is one of the minor prophets of the Old Testament, with a book named after him.

clue.text: Former artist, on the road, given some beef

parts.note: past means former, bygone
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
the M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI in crosswords

explanation.surface: A one-time painter on the road is handed some beef.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds; read as letters it is MI.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastrami is seasoned, smoked beef, typically brisket, served sliced.

clue.text: The party that's in

definitions.meaning: a reception held in one's own house
being in means not out, present in one's house

explanation.definitionFit: An at-home is a social gathering in a host's house, and someone in is present in their house.

clue.text: It's not effervescing, for all that

definitions.meaning: describes drinking water or wine without bubbles

explanation.definitionFit: Water without fizz is sold as non-sparkling, and the adverb means nevertheless.

clue.text: Courageous person, one with pride and male cunning

parts.note: a group of lions is called a pride
he is a male pronoun
art can mean craft or cunning

explanation.surface: A brave person is proud, manly and wily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pride' misleads as self-respect; it is the collective noun for big cats.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of great bravery, like Richard I, is called one with a lion's heart.

clue.text: High-powered woman returning, about to collect bag

indicators.note: to collect is to take in, so one set of letters holds another inside it
returning means going back, so the woman's name is read backwards

parts.note: Irene is a woman's name
to bag something is to get it
C, for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A dynamic woman comes back, about to pick up a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' gives ENERI, and 'to collect' makes that wrapper (with C) hold the bag; 'High-powered woman' tempts as the definition, but the woman is wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone full of vigour and drive is lively and forceful, as high-powered suggests.

clue.text: Recurring phrase in, mass accompanied by Klemperer, perhaps

parts.note: Otto Klemperer was a German conductor

explanation.surface: A repeated musical phrase in a Mass conducted by Klemperer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' shows Otto is an example of someone so named.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a motto is a short theme that recurs through a work.

clue.text: Like a dandy holidaying on the ranch?

definitions.meaning: in the manner of a foppish, overdressed man
a city tourist staying on a holiday ranch is called a dude, so this means in that tourist's way

explanation.definitionFit: A dude is both a fop and a city visitor to a holiday ranch, and the adjective means resembling one.

clue.text: A setter may be in it if a clue is faulty!

definitions.text: A setter may be in it if a clue is faulty!

parts.words: A setter may be in it if a clue is faulty!
parts.note: a setter is a breed of hunting animal kept in a kennel, and a crossword compiler who errs is in disgrace

explanation.definitionFit: To be in the kennel is idiom for being in disgrace, and a setter is a breed of gundog.

clue.text: Renegade first of all rejected work, say

indicators.note: the first of a word is its opening letter, here of all
rejected means thrown back, so the word is reversed

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
to state is to say

explanation.surface: A traitor first refuses all work, so to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who abandons their faith or party is a deserter of a cause.

clue.text: Woman's relatives binding old record in leather.

indicators.note: binding means wrapping round, so one set of letters encloses another

parts.note: she's kin means a woman's relations
an EP is an extended-play record, now old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A woman's family bind an old record in leather.
explanation.walkthrough: SHE'S KIN, the woman's relatives, wraps round EP.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheepskin is the hide of a sheep, often with fleece on, used as leather.

clue.text: Gray's view of Eton College, a possible source of riches

definitions.meaning: Thomas Gray wrote the poem Ode on a Distant ... of Eton College, describing the view
a site with promise of gold or ore for a miner

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a scenic view and a likely site for mining or a hopeful candidate.

clue.text: Fellow's attempt to hide one, where records are kept

indicators.note: to hide something is to enclose it, so one letter goes inside

parts.note: Reg is a man's name, and try means attempt
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A man tries to conceal something in a records office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to hide' puts I inside REG'S TRY.
explanation.definitionFit: A registry is an office where official documents such as births and marriages are filed.

clue.text: Have one's home in part of army camp

parts.note: the RE, Royal Engineers, are a corps of the British Army
a camp can be a side or faction

explanation.surface: A soldier lives in one section of an army camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'camp' misleads as tents; here it means a faction, as in 'the other camp'.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwell somewhere permanently is to live there.

clue.text: Luck now may come together for recipient of such aid

definitions.text: Luck now may come together for recipient of such aid

parts.words: Luck now may come together for recipient of such aid
parts.note: the two words Luck now joined give Lucknow, the Indian city whose besieged garrison was famously rescued in 1857

explanation.definitionFit: The rescue of besieged Lucknow in 1857 is remembered by this word for the lifting of a siege.

clue.text: Elevated platform to be used by rambling poet?

parts.note: something for someone is meant to be used by them

indicators.note: rambling means wandering aimlessly, so the letters of poet are jumbled

explanation.surface: A raised stage meant for a wandering poet.
explanation.definitionFit: A foretop is the platform at the top of a ship's foremast.

clue.text: Motivating spirit giving rise to ill feeling

definitions.meaning: in Jung, the inner driving soul or intention

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin word for mind or soul serves both for a driving intention and for hostility.

clue.text: Way old member's done lively jazz dance?

parts.note: St is short for street, a way
an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An old politician has done a lively dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A stomp is a jazz dance with heavy stamping steps.

clue.text: Dish served in Dad's Army?

parts.note: pa means dad, so pa's is dad's
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: A dish served up in the TV comedy Dad's Army.
explanation.walkthrough: Dad's Army is a classic British TV sitcom about the wartime Home Guard.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta is Italian noodle dough, served as a dish.

clue.text: Bird initially seen with mole outside entrance to park

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so take the first letter of seen

parts.note: and means together with

indicators.note: outside means the word goes round the other piece

parts.note: a mole is a breakwater or pier

indicators.note: the entrance to a word is its first letter, here of park

explanation.surface: A bird first noticed with a burrowing mole by the park gate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mole' looks like the animal but is a harbour wall; 'outside' puts PIER round P.
explanation.definitionFit: The sandpiper is a small wading shore bird.

clue.text: Jump up to grab commander's dog

indicators.note: to grab is to seize and hold, so one piece goes inside another
in a down clue up means read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: to hop is to jump
OC means officer commanding

explanation.surface: A dog leaps up to snatch its commanding officer's possession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' gives POH, read upward in this down clue, and 'to grab' sets the officer inside it; 'Jump' looks like the definition but the dog comes last.
explanation.definitionFit: Pooch is informal slang for a pet hound.

clue.text: Low regard in which judge holds one's set, unfortunately

indicators.note: holds means contains, so one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: to deem is to judge
I is one, so one's is I'S

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A judge has a low opinion of one's set, sadly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' yields ISEST, and 'holds' splits the judge after its first letter to take it in; 'Low regard' is the definition, not part of the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means lack of respect, the opposite of high esteem.

clue.text: Flog 24 outside university

indicators.note: outside means one piece goes round the other

parts.note: 24 across is a wading bird, and the knot is another such bird

explanation.surface: A beating is handed out beyond the university.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 is SANDPIPER; a knot is another kind of sandpiper.
explanation.definitionFit: A knout is a Russian whip, and as a verb it means to whip with one.

clue.text: One-sided support originally provided craftsmen with it

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so take the first letter of provided

parts.note: artisans are skilled craftsmen
being it means being fashionable, hip

explanation.surface: Biased backing first came from craftsmen with style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' means trendy, so HIP; 'with' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Partisanship is biased loyalty to one faction or cause.
